bio_md:
# 明孝宗朱祐樘 · 主要事迹

朱祐樘（1470—1505），[[ming-xian-zong|宪宗]]之子，母为纪姓宫女，幼年遭万贵妃之厄，藏于后宫密养。成化二十三年（1487）即位，改元弘治。

孝宗是唯一一夫一妻之帝，终身不置妃嫔。他任刘健、谢迁、李东阳等贤相，勤政纳谏，罢传奉官、裁抑中官，弘治之治为明中叶仅见之清明。史称「弘治君臣，有可称述」。

弘治十八年（1505）孝宗崩，庙号孝宗，葬泰陵。其独子[[ming-wu-zong|武宗]]即位后，明政又入于佚乐之途。

bio_parts_en.value:
by a palace maid named Ji, was hidden in the palace as a child from Consort Wan's malice. He took the throne in 1487, era Hongzhi.

Xiaozong was the only Ming emperor with a single wife, no concubines ever. He employed Liu Jian, Xie Qian, and Li Dongyang, heard remonstrance, cleared the transmitted offices, and curbed the eunuchs - the Hongzhi years were the cleanest of the middle Ming.

He died in 1505. His only son
undid much of it, but the Hongzhi example stood.
